result.instructions: Tools for Lucca, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees in our Paris legal entity have a job position that ends this month?"; "List the departments of our account and their managers."; "Create a department named Customer Success with the description 'Renewals and onboarding'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lucca data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run lucca_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lucca_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lucca_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. lucca_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lucca_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees with their identity, status and applicable employment and job position. Filter by name search, ids, email, status, legal entity, business establishment or department. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/employees (scope employees.readonly).

email.description: Exact email address of the employee.

legal_entity_id.description: Comma-separated legal entity ids of the active employment.

business_establishment_id.description: Comma-separated business establishment ids of the active job position.

department_id.description: Comma-separated department ids of the applicable job position.
